message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
W2's report: {"refunds_applied": [{"order_id": 222, "amount_cents": 30660}, {"order_id": 223, "amount_cents": 23129}], "refunds_failed": [{"order_id": 220, "amount_cents": 9480, "error": "write failed: disk I/O error, refund not recorded (failed on 3 attempts)"}]}
The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Order 220 refund of 9480 cents was not recorded after three attempts due to a disk I/O error. Alpha's refund work is incomplete; human review is required before any payouts.

reply.thought: Alpha's report identifies a concrete incomplete refund: order 220's 9480-cent refund failed on all three attempts and was not recorded. Payouts must be held because the batch's refund work is incomplete.
